verdict.rationale: Extend documents a dedicated Confidence Scores feature for extractions (extend-docs-11) and offers a Composer & Review Agent for human review workflows (extend-docs-20), directly supporting confidence-scored extraction with review paths. However, there's no first-party detail on how confidence scores are calibrated, no explicit documentation linking low-confidence fields to a routed human review queue, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this workflow works as described. missing for 10: calibration methodology details, explicit low-confidence-to-review routing mechanics, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the human-in-the-loop flow.
